meta.title: Device ID Provisioner
meta.description: Write attestation device IDs through Qualcomm QSEECom or MediaTek TrustKernel.
meta.warning: This has only been tested on some Qualcomm-based OnePlus devices. Results on other devices are not guaranteed, and a live write changes the IDs the Keymaster TA attests. TrustKernel provisioning is experimental. It writes rkp_flag and attestation_ids separately; a failure can leave a partial write. Verification checks object existence. MEID and QSEECom TA locations do not apply.

form.mainHint: Filled in from this device. Change them only to match the device you are aligning with.

form.dryRunHint: Build and validate the command without sending it to Keymaster.
